Closing as done (decision 5 on bridge-redesign child 030f-c14f-596a-4f79, 2026-08-06).

This ticket's acceptance criteria are already satisfied in-tree by audit_binding_drift, which reads bindings.json read-only and reports the binding-level drift the live pass would act on — see schemas/bridge_fsck.schema.json:5 and _engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:338,365,390,406. It is the one check in bridge fsck that does real work.

Remaining bridge-fsck work (retiring the three phantom SYNC-gated checks, the G2 store_integrity offline forward/reverse binding audit, and deleting the unreachable G1 alert counter) is tracked as 030f under epic 2f79 rather than inherited here, since this ticket's own parent epic 3006-e198-13db-4e1f is closed.
